title: Payoff Courtesy Credit on Holder Refunds
content:
# Payoff Courtesy Credit on Holder Refunds

Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda courtesy schedule. A refund released to the holder receives a flat payoff courtesy credit according to how many calendar days before the release date the lienholder's reported loan payoff date falls (the payoff date is day 0).

**Schedule**

- Loan payoff date more than 10 calendar days before the release date: 20.00 is added to the holder release.
- Loan payoff date 4 to 10 calendar days before the release date: 10.00 is added.
- In every other case (3 days or fewer): no payoff courtesy credit is added.

The credit is added to the holder release after the holder late interest has been rounded to the cent, and the release total is rounded half up to the cent.

**Boundary pairs**

| Days from payoff date to release | Credit |
|---|---|
| 3 | none |
| 4 | 10.00 |
| 10 | 10.00 |
| 11 | 20.00 |

**Basis question.** *Does the credit depend on the refund amount?* No; it is a fixed amount set only by the days between the reported payoff date and the release date.
